description: A ready-to-chart series of new MCP servers per UTC day for the last N days (1 to 365, default 30). Good for 'Show daily new MCP servers over the last two weeks'. Example: daily_new_counts(days=14) -> {series: [{date, new_servers}, ...]}. days is optional: with no arguments you get 30 days. The last day can be partial, see snapshot_at.

days.description: Number of days back from the snapshot date, 1 to 365. Optional, default 30.
days.title: Days

name: daily_new_counts
